Make your photos come alive

Living Cards turn one photo into a little moving world — with your message on it, ready to send to someone you love.

Made by hand, one photo at a time — life through color, layering and 3D effects.

▶ See how it works ✦ Bring yours to life ✦ The Difference

Who it's for

Anyone who wants a text or a card to actually land — a birthday, a thank-you, an I-miss-you that doesn't get scrolled past.

What it's for

Turning one photo you already love into a living moment with your words on it — a link to open, and a little film to text.

What's the problem?

Photos sit still. A plain picture text is easy to forget — it looks like every other picture in the thread.

Can you fix it?

Yes — that's the craft. Color that changes, layers that drift, a little 3D depth, music underneath. Honest work, no magic tricks.

How much does it cost?

A $10 donation brings two of your photos back to life — made by hand, one at a time. Not happy within a week? Our fee comes back to you in full.

There's nothing magic about this — basic, simple principles and art, turned into moments that last forever.

The Difference Wall

A photo takes a second. A living photo is what happens when you give that second time. 4K gives a photo more pixels. A living photo gives it back its feeling.

Same photo in both frames — the only difference is the time someone put into the artwork: hours of color, light and layers, instead of a snapshot.

Tap LIVING — the same photo wakes up in the same frame.

Your Photos, Back to Life

The pieces on this page weren't made by a machine in seconds — each one was crafted by hand, one photo at a time. That's the offer: send us yours, and we'll do the same for them.

Donate $10 — and we bring 2 of your photos back to life. That's $5 a photo.

Each photo comes back to you two ways: a living page link you can open and share, and a film you can send on WhatsApp.

1Tap Donate below and complete the $10 donation.
2Email your 2 photos to gary@drspanier.com
3We will try to bring them back to life — usually within a day — and email them back to you.

We will try to bring them back to life. Every one is made by hand and checked before it goes back to you.

✦ DONATE $10

Secure donation through Stripe.

✦ Our guarantee

Our guarantee: if you're not happy within a week of delivery, we refund our fee in full. The only penny we can't return is Stripe's processing fee — 2.9% + 30 cents, which is 59 cents on a $10 donation — because Stripe keeps it even when we refund you. So a $10 donation comes back as $9.41. 100% transparency: that's their fee, never ours.
